mainEntity.name: What factors affect the total cost of building an in-law suite?

acceptedAnswer.text: The overall cost to build an in-law suite varies significantly depending on whether you renovate existing square footage or construct a new structure. Converting an existing garage or interior room is generally the most economical path because the foundation, exterior framing, and roof are already in place. Building a ground-up attached home addition or a detached unit requires extensive groundwork, framing, new roofing, and tying into existing electrical and plumbing lines. Other major cost variables include whether you include a kitchenette or a full kitchen, the grade of finishes chosen, and whether bathroom features require specialized accessibility upgrades. Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms reviews these details during the initial estimate to provide transparent, customized pricing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on whether you build a new addition or convert a garage, the scope of kitchen and bathroom plumbing, structural framing needs, and material finishes.
